meta.name: implementing-devsecops-security-scanning
meta.description: Integrates Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) into CI/CD pipelines using open-source tools. Covers Semgrep for SAST, Trivy for SCA and container scanning, OWASP ZAP for DAST, and Gitleaks for secrets detection. Activates for requests involving DevSecOps pipeline setup, automated security scanning in CI/CD, SAST/DAST/SCA integration, or shift-left security implementation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把 Gitleaks、Semgrep、Trivy、OWASP ZAP 等安全扫描工具加入 CI/CD 流程，自动检查代码漏洞、密钥和依赖风险，并在发现问题时阻止合并或部署。
howto.when: 当你要求设置自动安全扫描、在 CI/CD 中加入 SAST/DAST/SCA，或实现“左移安全”时触发。

say.note: Claude 会给出 CI/CD 配置示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps integrate security scanning tools (Gitleaks, Semgrep, Trivy, OWASP ZAP) into CI/CD pipelines to detect code vulnerabilities, secrets, and dependency risks, blocking merges or deployments when issues are found.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up automated security scanning, integrate SAST/DAST/SCA into CI/CD, or implement shift-left security.
